results.evidence: test_database_read_failure_exits_1 monkeypatches report.build_report to raise sqlite3.OperationalError, runs main(['report', ... '--out', out]) and asserts code == EXIT_REFUSED, err.startswith('error: could not read the database:'), captured.out == '' and not out.exists(). Test run: 2 passed. I did not check that EXIT_REFUSED equals 1 or that the CLI calls report.build_report through the module attribute. The patch takes effect and the assertions pass, so both hold in practice.

In a copy under $TMPDIR (/tmp/claude-501/sir-probe-087), I changed only line 404 in _run_report's `except sqlite3.Error` handler from `return EXIT_REFUSED` to `return EXIT_OK`.
